name: Principal r. 1(2)(e) as made: six regulations after 150 days

attrs.quote: regulations 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 29 of these regulations shall come into force after 150 days
attrs.note: Substituted by the Amendment Regulations, 2018 (10 of 2018), which moved regulation 24 to 31 January 2019 and regulations 26, 27 and 25(1) to (4) to 28 February 2019.
